"""Price formatting helpers for the storefront."""


def format_price_usd(amount):
    rounded = round(amount, 2)
    whole, _, frac = f"{rounded:.2f}".partition(".")
    whole = f"{int(whole):,}"
    return "$" + whole + "." + frac


def format_price_chf(amount):
    rounded = round(amount, 2)
    whole, _, frac = f"{rounded:.2f}".partition(".")
    whole = f"{int(whole):,}"
    return "CHF " + whole + "." + frac


def parse_price(text):
    digits = text.replace(",", "").lstrip("$").replace("CHF", "").strip()
    return float(digits)
